response.description: Deployment templates in Azure Machine Learning add public preview support for deploying from registries, expanding the set of model registries that customers can use as the source for a templated deployment. Deployment templates package a model, deployment configuration, and container information into a reusable artifact that platform teams can share with development teams. This update makes it easier for platform owners to standardize how a team deploys curated models from registries, while preserving governance through the template itself. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Deployment Templates support packaging deployment configurations in registries for curated deployment
